metadata.name: Porites sp. Coral Geochemical Time-Series from TIAREI-A1, French Polynesia
metadata.description: High-resolution geochemical time-series dataset from a single Porites coral core (Event TIAREI-A1) collected at 15m depth in the Tuamotu Archipelago, French Polynesia. Contains 96 records of Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, and δ13C measurements spanning approximately 8 years (1999.71 to 2007.63), representing seasonal to interannual climate variability.
metadata.spatial: Point location (single coral core at 15m depth)
metadata.temporal: Sub-annual resolution (approximately monthly based on 96 records over ~8 years)
